title: Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond

entities.name: Lukka
entities.description: A Coppercoat captain of Drannith who bonds with a winged tiger, becomes an outcast bonder, goes mad with power at the Ozolith and ignites his spark.

entities.name: Jirina
entities.description: Lukka's fiancée and General Kudro's daughter, who becomes a colonel after Lukka's defeat.

entities.name: General Kudro
entities.description: Jirina's father, a sadistic general who hunts Lukka and is stabbed to death by him.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker who helps Lukka and later opposes him.

entities.name: Winged tiger
entities.description: The monster that bonds with Lukka, later rescues Jirina and is executed.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A planeswalker mentioned as someone who could help.

entities.name: Coppercoats
entities.description: The elite military force defending Drannith from monsters.

entities.name: Drannith
entities.description: The city defended by the Coppercoats.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: The plane of monsters where the story takes place.

entities.name: Ozolith
entities.description: A big crystal formation that is the source of the voice forcing monsters to attack Drannith; it explodes at the end.

entities.name: Skysail
entities.description: A flying boat city where the hunters hire a sky pirate ship.

events.summary: Lukka's squad faces a winged tiger that kills three of them until Lukka is bonded to it against his will.
events.quote: The cat kills three of his four squad members, only stopping when Lukka suddenly and unwilling bonds with the monster .

events.summary: Kudro imprisons Lukka; Jirina helps him escape by faking her kidnapping and Vivien scares off his pursuers.
events.quote: Jirina helps Lukka escape by faking her kidnapping.

events.summary: Lukka and Vivien find the winged tiger and learn the Ozolith is forcing monsters to attack Drannith; they escape the hunters on the tiger.
events.quote: they escape by riding the winged tiger.

events.summary: At the Ozolith Lukka connects his mind to the crystal, commands the Nightmares against the hunters and turns on Vivien and the bonders.
events.quote: Lukka commands all the Nightmares to attack the hunters, which leads to the pirates fleeing.

events.summary: Lukka decides to take control of the bonders' monsters and goes mad with power as Vivien flees.
events.quote: Lukka decides to take control of the bonder's monsters.

events.summary: The winged tiger saves Jirina and is shot and captured at Drannith; Jirina refuses to execute it.
events.quote: Jirina is ordered to perform the execution but refuses.

events.summary: Lukka witnesses the winged tiger's execution and marches his monster army on Drannith.
events.quote: He then witnesses the winged tiger being executed.

events.summary: Lukka stabs General Kudro to death at a parley; Jirina refuses to assassinate Lukka and flees into a river.
events.quote: He stabs General Kudro to death himself.

events.summary: Vivien and a bonder rescue Jirina, who takes control of Drannith's defenses.
events.quote: Jirina ends up taking control of the city's defenses

events.summary: Lukka overloads the Ozolith, which explodes, igniting his spark and sending him to another plane.
events.quote: This causes his planeswalker's spark to ignite and he planeswalks away.

events.summary: Drannith rebuilds with more tolerance for bonders; Jirina becomes a colonel.
